name: Four Seasons New York Downtown
insider_take: This isn't your typical Midtown Four Seasons – downtown's sleek glass tower puts you in the heart of where New Yorkers actually live and play.
whats_special: Located in Tribeca's coveted skyline, this 82-story architectural marvel offers unobstructed views of the Hudson River and city. The hotel occupies floors 39-82, with the famous CUT by Wolfgang Puck restaurant helming the culinary scene. You're steps from the 9/11 Memorial and surrounded by cobblestone streets lined with A-list celebrity homes.
pro_tip: Book a Hudson River-facing room on floors 60+ for stunning sunset views over New Jersey's skyline – the higher floors offer some of Manhattan's most dramatic vistas.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Stone Street's historic cobblestone dining district, weekend strolls through nearby Brooklyn Bridge Park, and exclusive shopping at Brookfield Place. The building's dramatic LED light installation makes it a neighborhood landmark after dark.
pros: Prime Financial District location with stunning harbor and city views
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards and amenities
cons: Business district location may be quieter on weekends
